runs.text:
Taken from Rick Astley’s sold-out Reflections Tour, this live performance of “Keep Singing” was recorded at London’s O2 Arena in April 2026.

Originally featured on Rick’s chart-topping album 50, this live version of "Keep Singing" is now included on the 10th Anniversary Deluxe Edition of 50, celebrating a decade since the album’s release.

50 (10th Anniversary Deluxe Edition) is out now via BMG.
